source_snapshot.procedure: Match recipe; clear logs; change all/random Security Configuration settings; save/reboot and confirm retention; Load Defaults/save/reboot and confirm SPEC; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; requires manual BIOS navigation but does not distinguish reversible policy from TPM/key/fuse/provisioning operations.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required security-owner approval, one reversible control, trust-state baseline, secret-safe evidence and recovery while excluding irreversible actions.

old_problem: The historical record awaited exact security setting semantics, reversibility, trust-state oracle and recovery because Master requests all/random modification and Load Defaults can alter provisioned security state.
disposition_reason: ED-11 expressly prohibits unapproved security/provisioning values and permits only safe reversible settings one at a time. Therefore this case can be defined around one security-owner-approved reversible non-secret policy, with TPM/key/fuse/ownership/provisioning actions excluded. Exact policy, provisioned project default, effective trust oracle and secure recovery remain runtime inputs.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2180, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2181 / Wistron-BIOS-00498-V004 / 1dfea9d79d4258f4 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Apply ED-11: never execute all/random or any unapproved security/provisioning value; allow one explicitly reversible control only.
Permanently exclude TPM clear/ownership, key enrollment/deletion, fuse/one-time, credential and secret operations from this test.
Bind BIOS/TPM/security firmware, Secure Boot mode/key identifiers, measured boot/attestation and protection baseline without exposing secrets.
Qualified operator and security owner jointly control KVM save/reboot/Load-Defaults; verify effective trust state as well as menu text.
Factory Load Defaults is not presumed to restore project keys/provisioning; sign project restoration and custody plan first.
No BIOS/security setting, key/TPM state, log, reboot, Load Defaults, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: ED-11 controlled reversible Security Configuration persistence and trust-state restoration
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved reversible Socket Security policy persists and returns to the exact provisioned project default without weakening or changing Secure Boot, TPM, measured boot, attestation, key identifiers or hardware protections.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator plus security owner
One reversible non-secret policy and provisioned project-default oracle
Key custody, incident and KVM/physical recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Security owner approves one reversible non-provisioning control. Operator captures baseline menu and secret-safe trust state, changes only that control through KVM, saves/reboots and verifies retained menu plus effective Secure Boot/TPM/measured-boot/attestation/protection state, then performs the specifically approved default/restoration action and proves the exact project state. Preserve all logs and stop on any unexpected trust delta.
test_case.expected_result: The single approved control persists, boot and effective trust state meet the signed oracle, and restoration returns menu plus provisioned security state and non-secret identifiers exactly to Project SPEC without key, TPM, attestation or protection drift.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when retention and project restoration are proven at both menu and effective trust layers. Unexpected key-ID/TPM/PCR/attestation/protection drift, boot rejection or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing reversible-policy, project-default or secure-recovery oracle is BLOCKED; irreversible/provisioning actions are out of scope and never N/A-by-assumption.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until security owner signs the exact reversible control, project default, trust oracle, custody and recovery.
No all/random, protection disablement, TPM clear/ownership, key enroll/delete, fuse, provisioning, credential or secret change.
Preserve TPM/event/SEL/boot/system evidence; redact secrets and never manipulate PCR/log state.
Operator/security owner controls every save/reboot/default/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/security-owner approval and platform security identity
Approved reversible control, project default/effective-state oracle and prohibition list
Baseline, changed, retained, restoration and final BIOS screenshots
Secret-safe Secure Boot key IDs, TPM/provisioning/PCR-policy, measured-boot/attestation/protection comparisons
Preserved event/TPM/SEL/boot/system deltas with secrets redacted
Restored project trust state, discrepancy/incident/recovery record and engineer/security-owner verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on any trust or boot anomaly. Security owner uses only the signed project recovery/custody process to restore the provisioned state; do not clear TPM, mutate keys, disable protections, clear logs, blindly reboot or retry.

source_conflict.reason: Target and acceptance consistently cover Security Configuration persistence/default restoration; ED-11 safely constrains the dangerous all/random instruction.

blocked.reason: ED-11 resolves safe semantics by excluding unapproved security/provisioning actions; the one reversible policy and trust oracle are runtime inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Platform security identity, one reversible control, provisioned Project SPEC default, effective trust oracle, Load-Defaults/restoration scope, custody and security-owner recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED BY ED-11 AS PARAMETERIZED MANUAL TEST; RUNTIME SECURITY CONFIGURATION AND EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO BIOS, TPM, KEY, LOG, REBOOT, DEFAULT, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Security/BIOS platform owner and qualified KVM/physical operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign the reversible control, trust-state oracle, custody and recovery before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.application: Explicitly limits BIOS tests to safe reversible one-at-a-time values and prohibits unapproved security/provisioning values.

project_authority: Security/BIOS owner signs control, project trust oracle, custody and recovery; operator performs manual workflow; security owner and end engineer own verdict.
